answers.1:
mariadb shop -e "SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Seoul'" > /tmp/q1.txt
cat /tmp/q1.txt

# WHERE 조건에 맞는 행만 남긴다
answers.2:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;' > /tmp/q2.txt
cat /tmp/q2.txt

# 큰 값부터 정렬한 뒤 위 3개만
answers.3:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT name FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 3000 AND 40000;' > /tmp/q3.txt
cat /tmp/q3.txt

# BETWEEN 은 양 끝을 포함한다
answers.4:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_cnt, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM orders;' > /tmp/q4.txt
cat /tmp/q4.txt

# COUNT(*) 는 행 수, SUM 은 합계, AS 는 결과 컬럼 이름
answers.5:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY city;' > /tmp/q5.txt
cat /tmp/q5.txt

# GROUP BY 로 묶으면 집계가 묶음마다 계산된다
answers.6:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;' > /tmp/q6.txt
cat /tmp/q6.txt

# WHERE 는 묶기 전 행, HAVING 은 묶은 뒤 집계 결과를 거른다
answers.7:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT c.name, o.id AS order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id;' > /tmp/q7.txt
cat /tmp/q7.txt

# JOIN ... ON 으로 같은 값을 가진 행끼리 잇는다
answers.8:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL;' > /tmp/q8.txt
cat /tmp/q8.txt

# LEFT JOIN 후 오른쪽이 NULL 인 행이 짝 없는 행이다
answers.9:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT c.name, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY c.name;' > /tmp/q9.txt
cat /tmp/q9.txt

# JOIN 을 이어 붙이고 GROUP BY 로 고객별 합계를 낸다
